item.title: Bounce Auction Launches Masters of Time, A Biweekly Auction Series of High-End Watches
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
The era of using crypto to buy or bid on real-world collectibles is here, and Bounce is leading the charge. We’re not just innovating onchain auction mechanisms — we’re expanding what can be auctioned onchain, from tokens, NFTs to tangible items.

Over the past years, Bounce has successfully hosted a few onchain auctions of iconic real-world masterpieces, including the Diamond Hand Necklace, Claude Monet’s Paysage painting, the Pumpkin bronze sculpture by Yayoi Kusama. And we’re just getting started — one of Bounce’s goals for 2025 is to make tangible luxury collectibles more accessible to everyone through blockchain technologies.

To bring that vision into sharper focus, we’ve launched Bounce Auction, a new branch under the Bounce umbrella dedicated to making real-world collectible auctions available onchain to a global audience.

Kicking off this initiative, Bounce Auction is rolling out Masters of Time, a biweekly watch auction series that offers the opportunity to own a high-end watch with just 5 AUCTION tokens. If you spend less than $100 on a lottery ticket and win a Patek Philippe, wouldn’t that make anyone’s day? We’re here to make that happen.

How Masters of Time Works

Every two weeks, a high-end watch (Rolex, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe etc.) will go up for grabs on Bounce’s app through our onchain lottery auction executed by smart contracts.

Here’s how each auction works:

  • Entry Tickets: Anyone can join by purchasing lottery entry tickets. Each ticket costs 5 AUCTION tokens..
  • Unlimited Entries: There is no cap on the number of tickets a single wallet can purchase. You can buy as many tickets as you’d like.
  • Open for One Week: Each lottery remains open for one week, giving users time to enter.
  • Winner Selection: After the entry period closes, our smart contract leverages Chainlink’s oracle services and random number generator to randomly select one winning ticket. The winner is announced the following day.
  • Probability: The more tickets you purchase, the higher your chance of winning — similar to a traditional lottery.

If your ticket wins:

  • You will receive an NFT that serves as digital proof of ownership of the watch.
  • To claim the physical watch, you’ll need to attend Bounce’s Token 2049 Singapore event and present the NFT to us.
  • The NFT is transferable, meaning you can also choose to sell or trade the ownership before claiming the watch.
Auction #1 Details

The Masters of Time series will kick off with the first auction featuring an Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Selfwinding watch, a refined evolution of AP’s iconic Royal Oak collection.

Learn more at: https://app.bounce.finance/launchpad/watch-random

  • Lottery Entry Time: May 19 11AM UTC ~ May 25 11AM UTC
  • Winner Announcement Time: May 25 1PM UTC
  • Ticket Price: 5 AUCTION (BEP20)

This is a rare opportunity to win an AP watch with just a few $AUCTION — follow Bounce Auction (@auction) on X to keep up with the auction updates. N

item.title: The Infinity Pump: Auction of Yayoi Kusama’s Bronze Pumpkin Sculpture
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
Bounce has been pioneering real-world collectible auctions by leveraging blockchain technology to bring fine art onchain, such as the Claude Monet painting auction in November 2024. Now, Bounce is partnering once again with SeoulAuction Blue and BounceBit to launch another onchain real-world collectible auction: the Infinity Pump Auction, featuring Yayoi Kusama’s bronze Pumpkin sculpture (Ed.87/100, 1998). This auction presents a rare opportunity for participants to not only bid on one of the most expensive bronze pumpkins with just a modest budget, but also join a thrilling lottery draw for a chance to win some $AUCTION tokens. This article provides a comprehensive guide to the auction.

About the Artwork

The iconic artwork featured in this Infinity Pump Auction is a bronze pumpkin sculpture (28.5 x 26.2 x 26 cm) created in 1998 by Yayoi Kusama, the Ed. 87 out of a limited series of 100 pumpkin sculptures. Previously sold for over $137K, this artwork ranks among the top five most expensive bronze pumpkins. With her signature polka dots in a robust medium installation, this Pumpkin symbolizes warmth, comfort, and the abundance of nature. These traits render this Pumpkin exceptional, setting the position uniquely within her celebrated oeuvre.

Provenance

Dynasty Gallery, Taipei

Acquired from the above by the present owner

Exhibited

Karuizawa, The Museum of Contemporary Art, Painters Across the Sea, 16 April — 28 November 2010 (another example exhibited)

About the Artist

Yayoi Kusama is a Japanese contemporary artist and a pioneering figure in avant-garde art and conceptual expression. Renowned for her bold use of repetition, pattern, and immersive installations, Kusama’s work spans painting, sculpture, performance, and installation, often exploring themes of infinity, self-obliteration, and psychological depth.

With a career spanning decades and continents, she has become an icon of both pop culture and contemporary art, continuing to inspire audiences with her fearless originality and unyielding creative vision.

According to a report by Artnet named “Introducing the Intelligence Report: The Year Ahead 2025”, Yayoi Kusama achieved total sales of $72.6 million, ranking 10th in the “Top 10 Artist by Total Sales Volume, New York Day Auctions, 2015 to 2024”. Moreover, Kusama soared to become a 3rd position in the “Most-searched 15 Artists: 2005 versus now” judged bysearches of the Artnet Price Database. Based on above records, Kusama’s continued global popularity cemented her status as “the world’s most popular artist” and ongoing gallery exhibitions makes highly desirable piece for both seasoned collectors and those new to her art.

Auction Details

Auction Link: https://app.bounce.finance/real-auction/pumpkin

The Infinity Pump Auction will unfold in two stages, giving participants multiple opportunities to benefit throughout the event:

Stage 1: Bid for the Pumpkin on Ethereum Network.

The auction starts with a 30-min countdown. Each bid costs 5 AUCTION and adds another 30 minutes to the timer. Each address can bid for unlimited times. There’s no fixed end time for the auction, meaning that the auction continues as long as the timer is active. When the countdown ends, the last bidder wins the Pumpkin. Winning isn’t about how much you bid, but about your strategy: you must be the final bidder before the timer runs out.

In addition, all bidders will automatically receive lottery entry tickets for a chance to win a share of the $AUCTION prize pool accumulated during the auction. Each bid gets you one lottery ticket. A limited amount of participants will be randomly selected by the smart contract to win $AUCTION rewards.

Stage 2: Win $AUCTION rewards for free on BNB Chain.

A portion of the $AUCTION accumulated from the Pumpkin auction will be distributed to this second stage through a lottery draw. Participants need to stake BB or Broccoli 3Ef (0x343E66bAD706EED4350fE96385ffc6336bd653Ef) to get lottery entry tickets. The smart contract will randomly select winners to receive $AUCTION rewards. After the lottery ends, all staked BB and Broccoli 3Ef tokens will be fully refunded, meaning winners can claim their rewards without any cost.

About Bounce Brand

Bounce Brand is a decentralized platform dedicated to innovating and fulfilling the evolving needs of the Web3 space. Established in 2020, Bounce Brand is known for offering Auction-as-a-Service, an onchain auction protocol empowering Launchpad services and permissionless auctions for tokens, NFTs and RWAs.

item.title: Introducing Auction Intelligence, An AI Agent Launchpad on BNB Chain
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
AI technology is transforming the blockchain space, revolutionizing how users interact with and benefit from DeFi products. Bounce Brand is embracing this shift by integrating AI agents and launching Auction Intelligence, an AI agent launchpad on BNB Chain, at 12PM UTC on March 3rd 2025. Users can create and launch their own tokenized AI agents or participate in existing agent token launches while engaging with AI agents built by others. All agent token launches on Auction Intelligence are exclusive to $AUCTION and $Broccoli 3Ef(0x343E66bAD706EED4350fE96385ffc6336bd653Ef) holders. This article provides a comprehensive guide on how you can engage in Auction Intelligence.

Overview

Auction Intelligence Website: http://ai.bounce.finance

There are two ways to engage:

  1. Create and launch your own AI agent and its token

Simply chat with our built-in, multilingual AI agent in your native language and provide the following information:

  • Agent’s token name, ticker, description, logo & banner
  • Choose your raise currency (pick only one): $AUCTION BEP20(0x1188d953afc697c031851169eef640f23ac8529c) or $Broccoli 3Ef(0x343E66bAD706EED4350fE96385ffc6336bd653Ef)
  • Customize tokenomics: Total supply is fixed at 1 billion. 40 % fixed for LP, the rest 60% split between your token launch supply and your own reserved allocation. Our AI agent will let you know the maximum tokens you can reserve. You can specify your own allocation within this limit and must purchase your reserved tokens at the launch price.

Once you send all the above information, our AI agent will help you create your own AI agent, mint your tokens and set up a lottery launch where a total of 300 tickets will be available, and the smart contract will randomly select 100 winners. The default raise target is 2000 AUCTION or equivalent value of Broccoli 3Ef with each ticket priced at 20 AUCTION or its equivalent in Broccoli 3Ef, but it may change depending on price fluctuations.

If more than 100 participants enter your lottery launch, your raise target is met and your agent’s token is considered “graduated” i.e. successfully launched. 2% of your total raise (in $AUCTION or $Broccoli 3ef, based on your selection) will be collected and split evenly — 1% for you as the creator and 1% for the launchpad. Then we’ll add liquidity in your chosen raise currency, allowing your graduated token to be traded on both PancakeSwap and this AI Launchpad.

2. Participate in existing token lottery launches

If you’re not interested in creating your own AI agents yet, you can browse existing agents and participate in live token launches using either AUCTION or Broccoli 3ef (as specified by the creator). If the lottery pool hits its raise target and you’re selected as a winner, claim and trade the tokens on PancakeSwap or on our AI Launchpad.

Lottery Launch Default Setting
  • Creator’s Token Total Supply: 1B
  • Creator’s Token LP Supply: 400M
  • Raise Target: 2000 AUCTION or 2981864 Broccoli 3Ef
  • Ticket Amount: 300 tickets
  • Ticket Price: 20 AUCTION or 29818.64 Broccoli 3Ef
  • Winner Amount: 100
  • Duration: 2 hours
  • Maximum Reserved Allocation for Creator: 20% of total supply
Bounce’s Example AI Agent & Token info
  • Agent’s Name: BOT
  • Token Name & Ticker: BOT
  • Total Supply: 1B
  • Creator’s Token LP Supply: 400M
  • Raise Target: 2000 AUCTION
  • Ticket Amount: 300 tickets
  • Ticket Price: 20 AUCTION
  • Amount of Token per Ticket: 6M
  • Winner Amount: 100
  • Duration: 2 hours
AUCTION Airdrop Campaign

For the first 10 days after launch, we’ll airdrop 1,000 AUCTION daily in an alternating pattern to ensure fair distribution:

  • Day 1: Airdrop to the creator & all lottery participants (including non-winners) of the highest market cap graduated token raised in $Broccoli 3Ef.
  • Day 2: Airdrop to the creator & participants of the highest market cap graduated token raised in $AUCTION.
  • Day 3: Back to the creator & participants of the highest market cap graduated token raised in $Broccoli 3Ef.
  • Day 4: Back to the creator & participants of the highest market cap graduated token raised in $AUCTION.
  • Pattern repeats till day 10.

The creator receives 10 AUCTION daily, while the lottery participants share the remaining 990 AUCTION.

A live leaderboard will track each graduated token’s performance, including market cap and number of holders.

Step-By-Step Guide

How to Create Your Own AI Agent & Token

  1. Visit Auction Intelligence’s website and connect your wallet first.

2. Once your wallet is connected, scroll down and click the avatar at the bottom right. Click “+ Create AI Agent.” Please note that once you create your AI agent and token, your token’s lottery launch goes live immediately and lasts for 2 hours.

3. Our built-in AI agent will send you a welcoming message which includes all the information needed from you. The AI agent is multilingual so you can type in your native language(Chinese, Korean, Japanese etc..) Start by sending your token’s name and ticker.

4. Then provide a description of the AI agent you want to create. This description should define how your AI agent responds to people. You can ask our AI agent to help you write a description as well.

5. Then provide a link to your token’s logo and banner (the banner size should be 799 x 383 for optimal display). Make sure to use a direct link to image files (like .png or .jpg) hosted on platforms such as:

  • Image hosting sites (e.g., Imgur, PostImage)
  • Cloud storage services (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox) with public sharing enabled
  • Your own website

Just make sure the links are accessible to everyone

6. Provide a link to your AI agent’s X(Twitter) profile if applicable.

7. Choose your token launch’s raise currency, i.e. whether you want your lottery participants to buy your token using $AUCTION or $Broccoli 3Ef.

8. Our AI agent will tell you the maximum amount of tokens you can reserve for yourself, and you need to specify your reserved amount (if you don’t want any then put 0.) You’ll need to buy the reserved tokens at launch price after your lottery launch ends.

9. Then the AI agent will send you a summary of all the info you’ve provided. Please review the info and ask the AI agent to proceed if it looks good or ask it to change any info needed.

10. You need to upload a banner for your AI agent to be displayed on the landing page.

11. Once you finish uploading the banner and reviewing all the info, hit “Launch Token with Agent” and complete your wallet interaction with our website.

12. Once your AI agent is created, you can hit “to my agent chat” to head to your agent’s profile.

13. Everyone including yourself can now chat with the AI agent you created. You can ask it to show you the token info etc.. To see your lottery token launch which is live once your AI agent and token are created, hit “Buy Token”

14. Your Lottery launch should look something like this (The parameters in the picture below are just the test version, not the official parameters.) If you reserve some tokens for yourself, you’ll need to wait till your lottery launch ends and buy the reserved tokens at launch price on this page.

How to Join an AI Agent Token Launch

  1. Visit Auction Intelligence’s website and connect your wallet first.

2. Once your wallet is connected, browse the existing AI agents and pick one with a live lottery token launch that you want to join.

3. You can chat with the AI agent about anything, such as asking it for the token info etc.. Hit “Buy Token” to join the live lottery launch.

4. Make sure you have sufficient balance for one ticket. Hit “Join” to buy a ticket to enter the lottery draw. Please note that the parameters in the picture below are just the test version, not the official parameters. Check the article above for official parameters.

5. Once you successfully complete your transaction, it’ll show that you’re already in the lottery draw. Each wallet address can only buy one ticket. If more than 100 addresses participate, the token is launched successfully (“graduates”) and the smart contract will randomly select 100 winners.

6. When the lottery launch ends, come back to the lottery page to check your result. If you’re selected as a winner, you can claim your tokens. If you did not win, you can claim your refunds.

item.title: The First On-Chain Auction of Claude Monet’s Paysage Concludes Successfully, Acquired by Oak Grove…
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
The First On-Chain Auction of Claude Monet’s Paysage Concludes Successfully, Acquired by Oak Grove Ventures

Bounce Brand, a leading on-chain auction platform, recently partnered with SeoulAuction Blue, an affiliate of Seoul Auction, Korea’s oldest and largest auction house, and BounceBit, a public blockchain powered by BTC restaking, to host a groundbreaking Real-World-Collectible auction of Claude Monet’s Paysage. This historic event marks the first time a Monet’s painting has ever been auctioned on the blockchain, merging the worlds of fine art and blockchain technology. The auction concluded successfully with the painting sold to Oak Grove Ventures, an investment firm specializing in early-stage investments with a primary focus on cutting-edge technology sectors such as Web3, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Biotechnology.

Artwork Details

The Paysage painting being auctioned on Bounce is an authentic masterpiece by Claude Monet, a celebrated French painter and the founder of Impressionism. The painting captures the fleeting beauty of nature with soft, atmospheric tones and a harmonious interplay of light and shadow. Previously auctioned three times at Sotheby’s, Paysage’s authenticity is underscored by its well-documented provenance and its enduring appeal to art collectors and Impressionism enthusiasts alike.

Auction Summary

The auction of Claude Monet’s Paysage commenced on Bounce Brand’s on-chain auction platform on November 18 at 4AM UTC. Conducted as an English auction on Ethereum with a floor price of 0.25 ETH, it attracted participation from over 600 unique wallet addresses. Approximately 16.5 hours after the auction began, Paysage was sold for an impressive 86.0405 ETH to Oak Grove Ventures.

To celebrate this iconic auction and reward all participants, a special memecoin known as the Memeory Coin will be launched. Blending the ethereal beauty of fine art with the cultural essence of memes, Memeory Coin is designed to create a lasting memory of this event. The auction winner, Oak Grove Ventures, will receive not only the authentic, tangible Monet’s Paysage painting, but also 1% of the total Memeory Coin supply. The remaining auction bidders who didn’t win will also equally share 9% of the total Memeory Coin supply.

Memeory Coin’s ticker and contract address will be announced shortly after 4AM UTC on November 23, followed by initial liquidity provision on Ethereum and Memeory Coin distribution to all participants.

Bounce Brand is a decentralized platform dedicated to innovating and fulfilling the evolving needs of the Web3 space. Established in 2020, Bounce Brand is known for offering Auction-as-a-Service, an onchain auction protocol empowering Launchpad services and permissionless auctions for tokens, NFTs and RWAs.

item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
Bounce Brand Partners with SeoulAuction Blue and BounceBit to Present the First On-Chain Auction of Claude Monet’s Paysage

Bounce Brand, a leading on-chain auction platform, is partnering with SeoulAuction Blue, an affiliate of Seoul Auction, Korea’s oldest and largest auction house, and BounceBit, a public blockchain powered by BTC restaking, to introduce a groundbreaking auction of Claude Monet’s Paysage. The painting, an authentic masterpiece by the renowned Impressionist, comes with its Provenance, provided by SeoulAuction Blue, ensuring its authenticity and historical significance. This historic event marks the first time a Monet painting will be auctioned using blockchain technology, merging the worlds of fine art and decentralized finance (DeFi).

About Claude Monet’s Paysage

Claude Monet’s Paysage showcases the master’s unparalleled ability to depict the fleeting beauty of nature. This serene landscape is rendered in soft, atmospheric tones, with a dramatic, cloud-filled sky that dominates the composition. The delicate interplay of light and shadow evokes a sense of tranquility, while subtle hints of distant structures reflect human presence within a vast natural expanse. A timeless example of Monet’s genius, Paysage is a coveted work for art collectors and Impressionist enthusiasts alike.

Auction Details

Pre-Auction Events

1. Memecoin Farming: Stake $AUCTION on Bounce and $stBB on BounceClub to farm Memeory Coins.

  • Start Time: November 18, 4:00 AM UTC
  • Unlock Time: November 23, 4:00 AM UTC

The earlier and more you stake, the higher your Memeory Coin allocation. Participants can claim back their staked $AUCTION or $stBB after the unlock date.

2. Price Speculation: Guess the final auction price of Monet’s Paysage painting by placing bids.

  • Time: November 18 — November 19, 4:00 AM UTC
  • Bid Price: 10 AUCTION or 500 BB per guess
  • Number of Bids per Address: Unlimited
  • Base Prize Pool: 888 AUCTION + 8888 BB

Each bid contributes to the prize pool. Correct guesses will share the accumulated prize pool, with rewards proportionate to the amount of bids placed.

Official Auction Period

  • Start Time: November 19, 4:00 AM UTC
  • Mechanism: English Auction
  • Floor Price: 0.25 ETH
  • Bid Increment: Between 0.1 ETH and 0.15 ETH

Each address can place only one bid at a time. If a higher bid is placed, the previous bidder will receive a full refund with gas fee compensation and a platform fee deduction. If no higher bid is placed within 6 hours, the last bidder wins the painting.

Post-Auction Activities

1. Memeory Coin Distribution & Initial Liquidity Provision

Total Supply: 184,000,000 Memeory Coins (commemorating Claude Monet’s birth year, 1840)

  • $AUCTION Farm: 2.5%
  • stBB Farm: 2.5%
  • Auction Winner: 1%
  • Auction Bidders (excluding the winner): 9%
  • Liquidity Provision: 85%

Based on Sotheby’s valuation, Monet’s Paysage is estimated at $200,000–$300,000. To make this historic auction accessible to everyone, we’ve set a low floor price of 0.25 ETH. If the final winning price reaches $300,000, over 600 addresses will be able to participate, and the 9% memecoin allocation for bidders who don’t win will be shared equally among them.

To ensure fairness, the Memeory Coin’s ticker and token contract address will remain undisclosed until just before distribution and liquidity provision. Please be cautious of impersonating tokens and rely solely on Bounce’s official announcements. After the initial liquidity provision, Memeory Coins will be tradable on Uniswap.

2. Painting Delivery

The auction winner’s physical address will be collected, and Monet’s Paysage painting will be delivered securely to them.

Throughout the history of mankind, we’ve been seeking eternity in the fleeting nature of our world. We strive to hold on, yet time and constant change elude us. This is what makes art so invaluable — a single moment of creation can resonate across generations, timeless and profound. Bounce Brand aims to merge the ethereal beauty of fine art with modern meme culture and blockchain technology, creating a magical bridge between tradition and innovation, where timeless artistry meets the boundless possibilities of the digital age. It’s more than just an auction — it’s a celebration of history, technology, and the future of global art accessibility.

About Seoul Auction Blue

Established in 2016, SeoulAuction Blue is the first art online-auction house in South Korea. SeoulAuction Blue has been making a new history on behalf of the Korean art auction market, having noticeable market penetration and auction sales records since its foundation. To encompass a group of generations, SeoulAuction Blue hosts online and offline auctions that reflect a variety of tastes and a cross-category selection, which include from Korean and international, modern, and contemporary art to exclusive collectible art, jewelry, wine. In 2020 SeoulAuction Blue started to diversify the service aiming to link between “Art and Finance.” To enhance the trading activity of art and cultural value assets, SeoulAuction Blue has encouraged financial institutions to participate in the market and to develop the art finance-linked products with expecting market expansion.

The BounceBit chain, a dual-token PoS Layer 1 secured by BTC and $BB, leverages Bitcoin’s security with full EVM compatibility. By designing liquidity custody tokens (LCTs) and partnering with CEFFU, users earn tangible interest from CeFi and utilize LCTs for restaking and on-chain farming.

What is Zulu Network?

Zulu Network is the first Native Bitcoin DePIN Layer optimized for AI + DePIN implementations. With Zulu, everyone will have the ability to stake assets, help facilitate operation of various DePIN and AI protocols and earn on the Bitcoin Network.

Zulu is an innovative blockchain protocol that combines the security of Bitcoin with the flexibility of EVM infrastructure to foster a new decentralized economy, focus on AI & physical infrastructures, and empower users to stake their assets to power the future of DePIN innovation.

Join their 770k+ users and start earning and shaping the future on Bitcoin with Zulu.

It powers decentralized physical infrastructure networks (DePIN) and AI applications, providing users with access to critical protocols while securing network operations.

item.title: Introducing BounceX, a Perpetual Exchange Powered by $AUCTION
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
Perpetual trading lets traders amplify their gains by holding leveraged positions without an expiry date — ideal for those who want to stay in the game as long as the market’s in their favor. While there are several derivatives exchanges in the crypto space, Bounce Brand is about to bring a unique twist this Q4: Meet BounceX, a perpetual exchange powered by Bounce’s native token $AUCTION. What makes BounceX stands out is that traders can use $AUCTION as the collateral asset to open and maintain leveraged positions, adding another layer of utility to the $AUCTION token. Let’s take a closer look at what BounceX brings to the table.

What is Perpetual Trading?

Perpetual trading is a form of derivative trading that lets traders speculate on the future price of an asset — like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or other cryptocurrencies — without actually owning the asset. Unlike traditional futures contracts, which have a set expiration date, perpetual contracts allow traders to hold positions indefinitely, as long as they maintain enough collateral to cover potential losses. This means traders can “go long” if they expect prices to rise or “go short” if they believe prices will fall, and they don’t have to worry about their position expiring.

A key part of perpetual trading is leverage. Leverage allows traders to control a larger position than they would with their own capital alone, amplifying both potential gains and losses. For instance, a 10x leverage means a trader can control $10,000 worth of assets with just $1,000 of their own money. This makes perpetual trading especially attractive to those who want to maximize their gains with smaller investments.

Another essential element in perpetual trading is the collateral asset — the funds traders put down to secure their positions. This collateral is like a security deposit, ensuring that if the trade goes south, the exchange can cover potential losses. Many exchanges allow traders to choose their collateral, often in stablecoins (like USDT or USDC) or major cryptocurrencies (like Bitcoin or Ethereum).

What is BounceX?

BounceX is a perpetual exchange that allows traders to engage in leveraged, perpetual trading with a unique twist: you can use Bounce’s native token, $AUCTION, as the collateral asset. This feature differentiates BounceX from most other perpetual exchanges, which typically require stablecoins or major cryptocurrencies as collateral. By enabling $AUCTION as a collateral option, BounceX not only expands trading flexibility but also adds a new layer of utility to the $AUCTION token itself.

On BounceX, traders can deposit $AUCTION to open leveraged positions, meaning they can control a larger market position relative to their initial deposit. The choice to use $AUCTION as collateral brings both benefits and strategic considerations:

  • Amplified Gains with Rising $AUCTION Value: When traders use $AUCTION as collateral, they benefit from any increase in its value while their positions are open. For instance, if the market value of $AUCTION rises while a trader’s leveraged position is active, the worth of their collateral also increases. This added value can amplify overall gains, as the trader now has more equity in their position and may be able to leverage this increased collateral for potentially higher returns.
  • Risks with Declining $AUCTION Value: On the other hand, if $AUCTION’s value declines, the value of the collateral also decreases. This can require the trader to add more collateral to avoid liquidation or maintain the same level of leverage, as their equity in the position has been reduced.

Leveraging deep liquidity from multiple platforms, BounceX aims to optimize users’ perpetual trading experience, ensuring smoother order execution and a more reliable market environment.

BounceX also plays an important role in broadening the use cases for $AUCTION, giving it increased significance within the Bounce ecosystem. Some existing use cases of $AUCTION include participating in IDOs on Bounce Launchpad, CeDeFi Mining, Bounce Booster. BounceX provides $AUCTION holders with an additional way to leverage their token holdings and potentially earn greater returns, while also supporting liquidity and value within the Bounce ecosystem.

Stay tuned for more updates on BounceX, coming soon this Q4.

item.title: Bounce Launchpad Partners with BounceBit to Support Projects on BounceBit Chain
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
Bounce Brand is thrilled to announce a strategic partnership with BounceBit, offering Launchpad support for top-tier projects deployed on the BounceBit (BB) chain. Community members will be able to participate in token launches on the BB Chain. Let’s explore the details of Bounce Launchpad and the BounceBit Chain.

What does Bounce Onchain Launchpad offer?

Bounce Onchain Launchpad is one of our core offerings, designed to empower projects by providing a robust platform for launching their tokens. Through the Launchpad, projects can conduct Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs), giving both Bounce users and project communities the opportunity to participate in early-stage investments. What sets Bounce apart is its range of auction mechanisms, allowing projects to tailor their token distribution strategies to best suit their needs.

In addition to the auction options, Bounce offers a comprehensive suite of services to support successful token launches. This includes dedicated marketing efforts to boost visibility, as well as technical support to ensure smooth execution throughout the process. To enhance the utility of our native token $AUCTION, users are required to use $AUCTION to participate in token launches on the Bounce Onchain Launchpad.

How to deploy on BounceBit?

BounceBit pioneers CeDeFi infrastructure, combining the strengths of CeFi and DeFi to offer institutional-grade yield products, restaking use cases, and CeDeFi as a service, making high-yield opportunities accessible to all. An integral part of the BounceBit ecosystem is the BounceBit Chain, a dual-token Proof of Stake (PoS) Layer 1 secured by BTC and $BB.

In a move to foster greater innovation, BounceBit recently passed a governance proposal to transition the BounceBit Chain to a permissionless model. This shift opens the door for a diverse range of projects to join the BounceBit ecosystem, helping to drive growth and advance new use cases within the network. item.title: Introducing Bounce Booster: Maximize Yield, Minimize Effort
item.dc:creator: Bounce Brand
item.content:encoded:
Bounce Brand is thrilled to present a new product — Bounce Booster, designed to streamline yield generation for users and enhance the utility of Bounce’s native token $AUCTION. Let’s dive into what Bounce Booster offers and how you can participate to earn yield.

What is Bounce Booster?

As the crypto space evolves, the number of decentralized finance (DeFi) and centralized finance (CeFi) yield offerings continues to grow, creating a vibrant yet often overwhelming environment for individual investors. Navigating this landscape requires significant research, constant monitoring of market conditions, and a deep understanding of various protocols, risks, and potential returns. The abundance of information can make it difficult for individuals to identify the most suitable opportunities and make informed investment decisions. It would be helpful to have a dedicated platform that aggregates different investment strategies and simplifies the yield generation process for users.

That’s why we created Bounce Booster, a platform designed to provide different investment strategies and simplify the yield generation process for users. By leveraging our resources and innovations in CeDeFi, Bounce Booster aggregates top CeDeFi offerings to ensure optimal yield for users who stake FSUSD and $AUCTION on Bounce Booster. Our protocol invests users’ stakes into premium CeDeFi strategies that combine the best of DeFi and CeFi, streamlining the investment process. All you need to do is stake on Bounce Booster, relax, and withdraw your profits — earning yield with minimal effort.

In addition, staking on Bounce Booster will earn you Booster Points which serve as a factor in determining users’ allocations from Bounce Launchpad IDOs. Your Booster Points accumulate until an IDO starts on Bounce Launchpad and reset to 0 after the IDO ends. The more you stake during each point accumulation period, the more Booster Points you’ll get and the more IDO allocations.

How to Stake FDUSD/AUCTION on Bounce Booster
  1. Visit https://booster.bounce.finance/strategy and connect your wallet first.

2. Once you’ve connected your wallet, go to the FDUSD pool to stake FDUSD or the AUCTION pool to stake AUCTION. (The staking and withdrawing processes are the same for FDUSD and AUCTION. Just make sure you’re at the right pool.)

3. Enter your desired staking amount and click “Approve” to approve the transaction within your wallet.

4. Once approved, click “Stake” to complete staking.

Please note:

*There’s a minimum 7-day lock-in period, i.e. profits begin to be generated 7 days after staking.

*You can unstake 30 days after staking. It usually takes 2–3 days to settle your withdrawal request. Withdrawals exceeding 10% of the total pool may take 7+ days to process.

*The APR shown is calculated based on previous data, serving as an estimate not a fixed expectation.
